reviewer: Independent AI documentation review, not a human
sampleMethod: Ten targeted high-risk records; not a random or representative sample
summary: Ten selected records were revisited against official documentation: nine retained their assessment (one with an explicit eligibility caveat), and QuickBooks gained a concrete production assessment gate. Research-agent follow-up also recovered official MCP evidence for Sentry and systeme.io. These are documented refinements, not a statistical accuracy estimate. Evidence refresh fetched 208 of 226 source URLs with HTTP 200. Retrieval failures remain in the run log; successful fetches do not establish claim accuracy.

reviews.name: Zendesk
reviews.before: New API token creation disabled; legacy token retirement scheduled.
reviews.after: Official migration timeline confirms October 27, 2026 creation block and April 30, 2027 final retirement.

reviews.name: Google Ads
reviews.before: Cloud-project access replaces legacy developer tokens.
reviews.after: Migration body confirms September 9, 2026 sunset; stale page summary still describes old onboarding.

reviews.name: Ahrefs
reviews.before: Paid-plan access with limited free test queries.
reviews.after: Official introduction confirms eligible paid plans and limited tests; key management requires workspace owner/admin.

reviews.name: QuickBooks
reviews.before: Sandbox keys self-serve; production setup separate.
reviews.after: Added explicit production app assessment requirement; sandbox access is not production approval.

reviews.name: Brex
reviews.before: Customer token and partner OAuth require account/admin access.
reviews.after: Brex quickstart explicitly requires a customer account and admin dashboard access.

reviews.name: Ramp
reviews.before: Customer admin or requested sandbox; OAuth.
reviews.after: Official overview separates customer, partner, and sandbox paths; authorization guide confirms client-credentials and authorization-code flows.

reviews.name: NotebookLM
reviews.before: Enterprise license and user IAM role required.
reviews.after: Official notebook-management API requires licensed authenticated user. Consumer product remains separate.

reviews.name: Otter AI
reviews.before: OAuth MCP; exact tier eligibility unknown.
reviews.after: Official page confirms OAuth and custom-client URL; FAQ says no public API key and directs unsupported clients to support. Tier eligibility remains unknown.

reviews.name: Consensus
reviews.before: Self-serve API key rather than assignment OAuth hint.
reviews.after: October 2026 official help confirms x-api-key and a shared API/MCP monthly quota.

reviews.name: higgsfield
reviews.before: Account sign-in and active paid subscription for CLI/MCP.
reviews.after: Official integration help confirms account authorization without API key and a paid subscription requirement.
